name: Mutsuki Koume
source:
Koume Mutsuki is the main heroine of the game. She is a leader in the school and known to be violent.
Koume likes Japanese chess and historical [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Japanese_television_drama]dramas[/url].
